name: blogpost
description: Multi-agent blog authoring with image curation and S3 sync. /blogpost:create runs a 6-agent pipeline (researcher → research-reviewer → image-curator → writer → writing-reviewer → html-renderer) over a topic, downloading CC-licensed images from the web and emitting a Jinja-templated blog HTML with floating TOC + figures, then syncs the entire folder to S3 via aws CLI. /blogpost:update pulls an existing blog folder back from S3 for round-trip edits. Bucket and prefix come from ~/.claude/blogpost.local.md.
